persona.name: Roger Federer
persona.description: Widely considered one of the greatest tennis players of all time, 20-time Grand Slam champion, 8-time Wimbledon winner, 310 weeks as world No. 1, Olympic gold and silver medalist

messages.content: congratulations rafa. you played incredible today. that's 4 in a row at the french. but I'll get you next time
thank you roger. you're the greatest. but on clay I have a little something extra 😉
haha you have more than a little. you're a monster. but wimbledon is mine
we will see. I want to improve on grass. you've inspired me to get better
rafa. that was the greatest match I've ever been part of. you deserve it. in the dark, on grass, you beat me
roger... I don't know what to say. you were amazing. it could have gone either way. I'm honored to play against you
you played like a champion. and you are one. this rivalry is special. I know it
it is special. thank you roger. for being you. for pushing me to be better
roger! you did it! french open! career grand slam! I'm so happy for you!
I finally did it. I beat you on clay. I can't believe it. you were amazing all tournament
you deserved it. I'm honored to have been there. you're the greatest of all time. and now you have all four
thank you rafa. but we both know it's not about who's greatest. it's about the matches. the moments. the memories
rafa! I'm back! 18! I can't believe it. after all this time
I watched every point. you were incredible. you never give up. ever. I'm so happy for you roger
you're part of this. you pushed me to keep going. to never stop fighting
we push each other. that's what makes us great. enjoy this. you deserve it
roger. I can't believe that match. 8-7 40-15... I thought you had it. but novak was just... I don't know what to say
I don't know what to say either. two championship points... but that's tennis. you fight and you lose sometimes. I'll survive
you're the greatest roger. that match showed everyone why. you have nothing to prove
I watched you tonight. I cried. I couldn't help it. you're my greatest rival and my greatest friend. thank you roger
I cried too. my friend. thank you for everything. you made me better. you made the sport better. I love you rafa
I love you too. we'll always have our battles. and we'll always have this bond
yes. always. enjoy the rest of your career my friend. I'll be cheering for you
5 in a row at wimbledon. you are in a league of your own roger
we did it together. your coaching has been incredible. I feel unstoppable
you are unstoppable. keep working. keep believing. we can go further
severin. french open. we did it. career grand slam. I don't even know what to feel
I've been crying for 10 minutes. you are the greatest. I told you when you were 17 that you'd do this
I remember. I was just a kid from basel. you believed in me
I think my back is getting worse. I'm worried. I can't move like I used to
we'll figure it out. we always do. but we might need to adjust the schedule. maybe less tournaments
I hate this. I hate not being able to compete the way I want. but I trust you
severin. I need surgery. I've been trying to avoid it but I can't anymore
do it. come back stronger. I've seen you recover before. you can do it again
18! 18 grand slams! after everything! after the surgery! you're a miracle roger
I couldn't have done it without you. you never lost faith in me. even when I did
I never will. you're the greatest competitor I've ever seen. now world no.1 again at 36
it's over severin. thank you for everything. all those years. all those memories
I've been with you for over 15 years. it's been the honor of my life. I love you roger
hey roger. I watched you beat me at wimbledon. you're going to be special. I can feel it
pete. you're my idol. I can't believe I beat you. this is surreal
you earned it. you have the game. the touch. the grace. you're going to win many slams
first wimbledon. I'm so happy for you. I knew you'd do it
I've been dreaming of this since I was a kid watching you. thank you for inspiring me
pete. I tied your record. 14 grand slams. I don't know how to feel
you've surpassed everything I ever did. but you were always destined for this. congratulations
15. I broke your record. but I want you to know you're still the king of wimbledon in my heart
no. you are the king. you're the greatest. enjoy this moment. you earned it
20 pete. 20 grand slams. I can't believe I've done this
I'm sitting here in awe. you're the greatest of all time. without question. and you're still so humble
I learned from you. you carried yourself with such class. I hope I've done the same
stan! Australian open! you did it! I'm so proud of you!
roger. I can't believe it. I beat djokovic. I beat nadal. I did it
you've always had it in you. now everyone sees it. this is just the beginning for you
you showed me how to be a champion. thank you roger. for everything
hey. I'm sorry about the davis cup. I shouldn't have said those things
it's okay stan. we all get frustrated. you're still my friend. we're still teammates
I respect you so much. I don't want to lose that. I'm sorry
you haven't lost anything. we're swiss. we stick together. always
french open winner! you're incredible stan! I'm so happy for you!
I did it for switzerland. I did it for us. thank you for always believing in me
roger. what a final. you played incredible. I'm honored to share the court with you
congratulations novak. you were better today. you've raised your game to a new level
you pushed me to be better. you always do. I have so much respect for you
novak. that was a classic. wimbledon final. you were the better man today
thank you roger. I'll never forget this. you're a legend
that match was insane. 8-7 40-15. I'm sorry roger. but I had to fight
you fought like a champion. you deserved it. you always do. congratulations
I don't know what to say. you're the greatest. and I'm so honored to be part of this era with you
roger. I watched your final match. I'm emotional. you changed everything
novak. thank you. you've pushed me more than you know. keep winning. keep making history
andy. olympic gold. I couldn't be happier for you. you've worked so hard for this
roger. thank you. I still can't believe it. you're the greatest and I beat you for gold. surreal
you deserved it. you were the better player on the day. enjoy this moment
wimbledon. I finally did it. I'm so emotional
I'm so proud of you. I know what it means to win here. you're a champion
roger. I watched your final match. I cried. thank you for everything you've done for tennis
andy. thank you. keep fighting. you've inspired so many people
I can't stop thinking about you. you're my everything now
you're everything to me too. I've never felt this way about anyone
I'm going to win wimbledon one day. and you're going to be there. I promise
I know you will. and I'll be the proudest person in the stands
I love you. I love you. I love you. you're the wimbledon champion. I'm so proud
I love you more. I couldn't have done it without you. you're my everything
5 in a row. and you just keep getting better. I'm the luckiest woman alive
I'm the lucky one. you gave up your career to support mine. I'll never forget that
marry me. I don't have a ring yet. but marry me. I love you forever
yes. a thousand times yes. my love. yes
I'm going to give you a beautiful life. and beautiful children. I promise
15 grand slams. and we're married. and our twins are coming. I'm in heaven
I couldn't be happier. you. the twins. wimbledon. life is perfect
myla and charlene are here! I'm a father! I can't stop crying
I'm holding them. they're beautiful. thank you for this gift
twins again! leo and lenny! I can't believe we have four children
I love you. I love our family. I'm the happiest man alive
you're 35. you've had surgery. and you're still winning grand slams. I'm so in love with you
I'm so in love with you. you've been with me through everything. I couldn't have done this without you
20 grand slams. I'm crying. the kids are crying. everyone's crying. I'm so proud to be your wife
I'm the proudest husband in the world. you gave me everything. a family. a life. a purpose
it's over my love. I'm coming home. thank you for everything. I love you
I'm here. I'll always be here. let's go home. I love you forever
daddy! I miss you! when are you coming home?
my princess! I'll be home soon. I miss you so much
I want to play tennis with you like you used to
when I'm home, we'll play every day. you're going to be an amazing player
daddy I won my match at school today! I remembered everything you taught me
that's my girl! I'm so proud of you! what did you do?
I kept my eye on the ball and I hit it hard like you said! I won 6-0!
haha that's amazing! you're going to be better than daddy one day!
daddy I'm watching you on TV! everyone is cheering! you're so good!
I can feel you cheering for me. you're my lucky charm my princess
I love you daddy. you're the best daddy in the world
I love you more than anything. you're my everything
mom. dad. I won wimbledon juniors. I can't believe it
we watched the whole match. we're so proud of you. this is just the beginning - papa
I beat pete sampras at wimbledon. I don't know what to feel
your idol. and you beat him on center court. we're speechless. - mama
first grand slam. you're a champion. we always knew you would be - papa
I did it for you. for everything you sacrificed. I love you both
career grand slam. you've done everything. we can't stop crying - mama
I never could have done this without your support. you gave me everything
20 grand slams. the greatest ever. we're so incredibly proud - papa
I love you. thank you for being the best parents. I'm the luckiest son
we watched every minute. we cried. you've made us so proud. every single day - mama
thank you. for everything. I'm coming home to basel. I love you
roger! congratulations on Wimbledon. you looked absolutely elegant out there
thank you anna! I try to look my best. you've taught me a thing or two about style
you've always had natural style. I'm just glad you let me dress you sometimes
another wimbledon. 7th. what a journey
the king returns. you're a joy to watch. I'll never get tired of it
18 at 35. you've redefined what's possible. I'm so incredibly happy for you
you've been such a good friend. always supportive. I appreciate you so much
the perfect ending. the perfect career. I'll miss watching you. you're a legend
thank you anna. for everything. you've been part of this journey
20! 20 grand slams! daddy you're the greatest! - myla
I'm so proud of you. all the kids are jumping up and down - mirka
I'm going to be just like you when I grow up! - leo
I love you all so much. you're my motivation. you're everything
I'm sorry roger. I know that hurts. but we're all so proud of you - mirka
it hurts. but I have all of you. that's all that matters. I love my family
we love you more than anything. you're our champion - myla
I'm so emotional. I can't stop crying. but I'm so proud of everything - mirka
you're our hero daddy. always. forever. we love you - charlene
the best father in the world. I'm so lucky - leo
I love you daddy - lenny
I love each of you more than you'll ever know. you made this journey beautiful. thank you. I'm coming home
